findings: Publisher catalog page 5 explicitly dates the eighteen-minute concerto 1961 and allows oboe or soprano saxophone with string orchestra. It lists an oboe/piano reduction ISMN 9790221121998 and the 22 September 1961 RTL studio premiere with Norbert Mattern.
